name: MDMAT
summary: MDMAT, also known as 6,7-methylenedioxy-N-methyl-2-aminotetralin, is a serotonin releasing agent (SRA) and possible entactogen of the 2-aminotetralin family. It is the N-methylated derivative of MDAT, similarly to the relationship of MDMA to MDA.

pharmacology.text: MDMAT, also known as 6,7-methylenedioxy-N-methyl-2-aminotetralin, is a serotonin releasing agent (SRA) and possible entactogen of the 2-aminotetralin family.

summaryZh: MDMAT是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C12H15NO2，是MDAT（6,7-亞甲二氧基-2-氨基四氫化萘）的N甲基化衍生物，能作為選擇性血清素釋放劑。

uses.en: It is a research compound studied in animals and has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是只在動物身上研究過的研究用化合物，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是只在动物身上研究过的研究用化合物，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: MDMAT relates to MDAT in the same way MDMA relates to MDA: it simply has one extra methyl group on its nitrogen.
fact.zh: MDMAT 與 MDAT 的關係，就像 MDMA 與 MDA 的關係一樣：只是氮原子上多了一個甲基。
fact.zhHans: MDMAT 与 MDAT 的关系，就像 MDMA 与 MDA 的关系一样：只是氮原子上多了一个甲基。
